preconditions.description: Number of vertices and edges are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range.

postconditions.description: If a solution exists, it must consist of m/2 paths. Otherwise, it must be 'No solution'.

postconditions.expression: all((xi, yi) in edges and (yi, zi) in edges for xi, yi, zi in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each path must consist of two adjacent edges in the original graph.

postconditions.expression: len(set(edge for path in return_value for edge in [(path[0], path[1]), (path[1], path[2])])) == m
postconditions.description: All edges must be used exactly once across all paths.
